name: Financing Benefits — Backlot
html:
It can be painful to finance an ADU. That's why we built financing for Haven, with lower rates and easier terms than a typical second mortgage.

  • Rates as low as 6.25% APR, meaningfully lower than the average second mortgage.

  • No payments and no interest for the first six months while permits are pending.

  • Finance up to 100% of Haven, including installation and closing costs.

  • Available for a primary residence, a second home, or a rental property.

  • No refinancing needed, fewer fees, and no prepayment penalties.

  • Designed exclusively for Haven. Only available through Backlot.

name: Testimonial — Backlot
html:
What mattered most when choosing who would build your ADU?

We wanted a true prefab unit and a company that could carry us through permitting, design, and construction as one process. We also needed confidence that the company was stable and well-backed.

Why did you choose Backlot?

We toured the showroom in Portland and liked the build quality of the units in person. The Two Bedroom fit our lot, and the team handled a tricky grading issue that two other builders had turned down.

What made you rule out a general contractor?

A general contractor meant a slower design process and months of on-site construction. We didn't love the floor plans from other prefab companies either, and most of them weren't even licensed in our state.

name: How It Works — Birchyard
html:
How it works

Getting a Nook is easy.We handle everything. You decide what to do with it.

  1. Step 1

    Explore and design

    Pick a size, a roofline and a color palette, then preview the result in a 3D configurator before you commit to anything.

  2. Step 2

    Permitting and financing

    Our team pulls the permits your city requires and pairs you with a financing plan sized to your project.

  3. Step 3

    Built in our factory

    Your Nook is assembled indoors on a fixed production line, away from weather delays and site-built guesswork.

  4. Step 4

    Delivered and installed

    We deliver the finished home to your yard, connect it to utilities, and hand you the keys, usually in weeks, not years.

name: Customer Story — Birchyard
html:
Above: The yard includes a young lemon tree, a stand of bamboo, and a gravel meditation path.

What mattered most when picking who would build your ADU?

We wanted a prefab unit and a company that offered a single point of contact from permitting through construction, plus real assurance they'd still be around to honor the warranty.

Why did you choose Birchyard?

We toured the Redwood showroom and liked how the units were actually built. The One-Bed fit our side yard, and their team solved an access-ramp problem two other builders wouldn't touch.

What made you rule out a general contractor?

A GC would have meant a slower design phase and a longer, messier build on-site. We also just preferred Birchyard's layouts to anything the other prefab companies showed us.

"I was qualified to design my own ADU, but I didn't have the time or energy to build something from nothing. So I looked to people who already had."

— Priya N., Nook homeowner since 2025
